skill.description: Use inference.sh to run Google Gemini image models for text-to-image generation, image editing, multi-image input, aspect ratios, resolution choices, and search-grounded prompts.

skill.author: tul-sh

security_audit.summary: The static Ruby backtick and hardcoded URL alerts are Markdown formatting, examples, and documentation links, so I marked them false positive. The real risk is contextual: the skill grants broad infsh CLI access and sends prompts, image URLs, and optional input files to external inference services. No prompt injection language was found.

remediation.suggestion: Constrain allowed-tools to the minimum infsh subcommands and app IDs where possible. Require user confirmation before commands upload files or URLs.
Add a privacy warning that prompts, image URLs, and input files may be processed by inference.sh, Google, and linked services.
Mark related npx installation commands as optional and recommend reviewing each referenced skill before installation.

content.value_statement: Users need a quick way to run Gemini image models from an AI assistant. This skill provides CLI patterns for generation, edits, ratios, and grounded prompts.
actual_capabilities: Shows how to sign in to inference.sh with infsh login.
Runs Gemini 3 Pro Image and Gemini 2.5 Flash Image app commands.
Creates text-to-image requests with prompt, ratio, count, and resolution options.
Edits images by passing input image URLs to Gemini image models.
Uses optional Google Search grounding for current-context image prompts.
Shows a sample-input workflow with infsh app sample and input.json.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh CLI and an authenticated account before use.
Sends prompts and referenced images to external services for processing.
Model names, availability, and output options can change outside the skill.
Does not include built-in moderation, rights checking, or storage management.

use_cases.title: Create Campaign Visuals
use_cases.description: Generate multiple concept images for ads, social posts, or landing pages with controlled aspect ratios.

use_cases.title: Explore Product Imagery
use_cases.description: Draft product scenes, style variations, and background edits before commissioning final assets.

use_cases.title: Automate Visual Prototypes
use_cases.description: Use CLI requests to create repeatable image generation flows inside assistant-driven work sessions.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Image Request
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a square Gemini image of a modern desk setup with natural light and clean composition.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Model and Ratio
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Gemini 3 Pro Image to create a 16:9 cinematic mountain landscape with northern lights.

prompt_templates.title: Edit an Existing Image
prompt_templates.scenario: Image transformation with a source URL
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit this image URL by adding a rainbow in the sky while preserving the landscape and lighting.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Grounded Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt with sample input and grounding
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an input file for a search-grounded Gemini image showing current Tokyo weather as an artistic scene.

output_examples.input: Generate four minimalist coffee shop logo concepts with Gemini 2.5 Flash Image.
output_examples.output: The skill prepares an inference.sh request for four Gemini image outputs using a concise logo design prompt.

output_examples.input: Create a 4K illustration of a medieval castle with detailed stone textures.
output_examples.output: The skill selects the higher quality Gemini image model and includes the requested 4K resolution option.

output_examples.input: Add a rainbow to an existing landscape image from a URL.
output_examples.output: The skill formats an image-editing request that passes the source image URL and the edit instruction.

best_practices: Describe subject, style, composition, lighting, and important details in one clear prompt.
Use Gemini 3 Pro Image when quality matters more than speed.
Confirm that prompts and image URLs are safe to send to external services.
anti_patterns: Do not include private documents, secrets, or unreleased product images in prompts.
Do not request broad image batches before testing one prompt and model choice.
Do not install related skill bundles without reviewing their source and permissions.

faq.question: What does this skill use to generate images?
faq.answer: It uses the inference.sh CLI to run Google Gemini native image apps.

faq.question: Does it work in Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Can it edit existing images?
faq.answer: Yes. It can pass input image URLs to supported Gemini image editing workflows.

faq.question: Can it create more than one image?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples include a num_images option for multiple outputs.

faq.question: Does it require an external account?
faq.answer: Yes. Users need the inference.sh CLI and authentication before running app commands.

faq.question: What should users avoid sending?
faq.answer: Users should avoid private images, confidential prompts, credentials, and content without proper rights.
